[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Load-tolerant suite-gate integration budgets[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate: replace the fixed 60s/20s/10s/15s wall clocks in the suite-gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]integration test with budgets calibrated from measured child admission [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]latency, and fail with child diagnostics instead of a bare [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TimeoutExpired.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close the ACE visual convergence gap[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]visual[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]visual: stop Textual animations from running under PNG snapshot tests [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and teach the convergence helper to treat pending animations as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unfinished work, so a starved app cannot present five identical [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mid-animation frames.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Revalidate and record the contention baseline[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]baseline[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate, visual[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]integration test under load, confirm both phases hold together, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refresh the recorded harness baseline.[/#D7D7AF]
